text_block_list.text:
Despite her petite frame, she possesses a captivating late kick,
and above all, a fierce hunger for victory—the umamusume Narita Taishin.

While looking into her background,
I found video footage of a race she ran prior to enrolling...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Hah*, *hah*, *hah*...

Running across the track, Narita Taishin shows no trace of panic.
Though positioned toward the back, she maintains a calm, composed stride.

The pace unfolded at a crawl. In situations like this, the frontrunners
can preserve their stamina till the end, giving early pacers the advantage, yet—
Narita Taishin spectacularly shattered that conventional wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...RAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

An eye-opening burst of sharpness.
Terrifying explosive acceleration.

Running like a demon consumed by sheer determination,
Narita Taishin had seized victory—!

I quickly flip through the enclosed documents to check her split times.
It was a slow-paced race, so the first half was naturally on the slower side, but—

In the second half, especially over the final three furlongs,
her speed was breathtaking compared to any other race of the same distance!

Right now, maybe due to her impatience, she drains herself fighting for position early on,
leaving her unable to launch her late-race surge. But—
choice_data_list: (If she can stay calm and bide her strength—!)

text_block_list.text:
The moment that thought strikes me, unable to sit still for another second,
I find myself rushing straight toward Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You're the one from yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! That's the Trainer who was with Taishin last night!!
Could this mean... could it really mean—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A SCOUTING OFFER!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this?
After how pissed off I was yesterday, what's your deal...?
Seeing Narita Taishin's confusion, I tell her that I watched footage of her past races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. And?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Th...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-T—
THAT'S SO TOOOOUUUUCHIIIIINGGGGG!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So passionate!! This Trainer has so much fire!!
Taishin, this is definitely a good person, I know ittttt—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up... You think literally everyone is a good person...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, so, are you gonna accept the offer!?
Are you gonna sign the contract!?!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: W-Who would ever team up with someone so suffocatingly—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I see. If only you had been willing, all our problems would be solved.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive my intrusion. However, this matter requires urgent attention.
Could you come with me, Narita Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: P-President!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To put it bluntly—
voices calling for your expulsion have been growing increasingly loud.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if for the sake of extra training, your repeated curfew violations and disregard for school rules—
combined with your recent lackluster results and physical concerns, have been brought to our attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have pushed back, but frankly, we find ourselves entirely cornered.
...Which is why I must ask for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My... cooperation?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. While those concerns were primarily raised
by the academy's instructors and trainers—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The most effective way to overturn them is to demonstrate your strength and potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Please, overturn this negative reputation with everything you have, Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Overturn my reputation...? What am I supposed to do out of nowhere—)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UUWAAAAAAAHHHH!!
Expulsion is out of the question, TAAAIIISHIIIIINNNN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: T-Ticket, you... Were you eavesdropping on us!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh! I was just listening with all my might!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That is literally what eavesdropping means...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, but this is an emergency far exceeding what I had heard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide!? Not you too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Every single one of you, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Well then. If we are to achieve the task presented by the President,
there is only one path available to us.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a way!? As expected of Hayahideee!
What is it, what should we do!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why are you the one getting all fired up...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to demonstrate your potential—and raise expectations for your racing capability—
then naturally, the only fitting stage is a race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You should gather participants and hold a mock race, Taishin.
We shall run in it as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
OOOOOHH!!
Yeah, exactly, let's race together, Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Is this pity? Are you gonna go easy on me or something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. ...Heh, in any case, there is one horsegirl standing right here
who could never fathom the concept of holding back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well............ yeah, fair enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Our reason for proposing this is truly simple.
Yet simple matters are often the hardest to explain in words.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Therefore—I look forward to the mock race, Taishin.
